title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Flat tax giveaway

$15,431 FOR THEM. $87 FOR YOU.

ITEP's estimate of the average 2024 Louisiana tax cut for the top 1% versus the middle fifth.

Bring back fair rates.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Sales tax hike

THEY RAISED YOUR SALES TAX TO CUT THEIRS

Louisiana raised the state sales tax to 5% in 2025 while cutting the top income and corporate rates.

Call your legislator. Demand a fair swap.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Billionaire rate

BILLIONAIRES: 8.2%

White House economists estimated the 400 richest families paid that federal income tax rate, 2010 to 2018, counting their gains.

Make the rich pay their share.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Buy borrow die

BUY. BORROW. DIE. TAX-FREE.

Stepped-up basis wipes out taxes on a lifetime of gains. Cost in 2026: $73 billion, says the Joint Committee on Taxation.

End the step-up.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Wages vs capital gains

SWEAT TAXED AT 37%. STOCKS AT 20%.

Top federal rates on wages versus long-term capital gains, 2026.

Tax money like work.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Payroll tax

7.65% FROM THE FIRST DOLLAR

Workers pay Social Security and Medicare tax on every paycheck. No loopholes, no deductions.

Workers already pay.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Zero-tax corporations

88 CORPORATIONS. $0 FEDERAL INCOME TAX.

ITEP found at least 88 profitable U.S. corporations paid nothing on more than $105 billion in 2025 U.S. profits.

Make corporations pay.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Tesla taxes

$5.7 BILLION IN PROFIT. $0 IN TAX.

ITEP: Tesla paid no federal income tax on almost $5.7 billion of U.S. income in 2025.

No more free rides.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Tech giants

$315 BILLION IN PROFIT. 4.9% IN TAX.

Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Tesla in 2025, per ITEP. That's $51 billion avoided.

Big Tech, pay up.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Rebates to profitable firms

YOU PAID. THEY GOT A REFUND.

ITEP found 88 zero-tax corporations collected $4.7 billion in federal tax rebates for 2025.

End corporate welfare.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Oil company taxes

BIG OIL: 6% ON $23 BILLION

FACT Coalition: Chevron, ConocoPhillips and Exxon's average effective federal rate on 2025 U.S. profits.

Our coast. Our tax base. Pay up.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
IRS cuts

THEY FIRED THE AUDITORS

IRS exam and collection staff fell about 36% by January 2026, says the Treasury inspector general.

Fund enforcement on the rich.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Audit revenue drop

AUDIT MONEY DOWN 35%

IRS exam revenue fell from $10 billion to $6.5 billion in fiscal 2025, per TIGTA.

Rehire the agents. Audit the top.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Who gets audited

AUDIT THE RICH, NOT THE WORKING POOR

TRAC: low-income EITC filers got about 48% of IRS audits in 2022 while filing 14% of returns.

Flip the audits.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Tax gap

$539 BILLION IN UNREPORTED INCOME

Underreporting made up 77% of the IRS's $696 billion gross tax gap estimate for 2022.

Collect what's owed.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
2025 law distribution

TOP 20% GET ALMOST 60%

Tax Policy Center: share of 2026 tax cuts under the 2025 law going to the top fifth.

Repeal the giveaway.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
2025 law bottom fifth

$150 FOR US. $12,000 FOR THEM.

Tax Policy Center: average 2026 tax cut, bottom fifth versus top fifth, under the 2025 law.

Fair taxes now.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Deficit from tax law

$3.4 TRILLION. THEN THEY CUT MEDICAID.

CBO: the 2025 law adds about $3.4 trillion to deficits over ten years.

Tax cuts for the rich are not free.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
2017 law top 1%

$51,000 FOR THE TOP 1%. $900 FOR THE MIDDLE.

Tax Policy Center estimates of 2018 average cuts from the 2017 tax law.

Never again.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Tax expenditures

$2.3 TRILLION IN HIDDEN SPENDING

That's what JCT projects tax breaks will cost in 2026. Much of it flows to the top.

Audit the tax code.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Capital gains break

$252 BILLION A YEAR FOR INVESTORS

JCT: cost of lower rates on capital gains and dividends in 2026.

Tax wealth like wages.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Pass-through deduction

THE BOSS GETS A 20% DEDUCTION. YOU DON'T.

The pass-through deduction costs $76 billion in 2026, per JCT, and the 2025 law made it permanent.

Same rules for everyone.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Carried interest

PAY IS PAY

Fund managers still get capital gains rates on much of their compensation through carried interest.

Close the carried interest loophole.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Profit shifting

EARNED HERE. BOOKED IN BERMUDA.

Economists estimate about 36% of multinational profits were shifted to tax havens in 2015.

Tax profits where they're made.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Industrial exemptions

$20 BILLION OUT OF OUR PARISHES

Local industrial tax breaks Louisiana has awarded since 1998, per an Ohio River Valley Institute analysis.

Make the plants pay.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Job requirement dropped

NO JOBS REQUIRED

Landry's 2024 order removed the job creation requirement from Louisiana's industrial tax exemption.

Pack your parish board meeting.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
LNG exemptions

$6.7 MILLION PER PROMISED JOB

Sierra Club estimate for property taxes nine Louisiana LNG terminals would skip.

Gas exporters, pay your parish.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Plaquemines schools

PLAQUEMINES KIDS LOSE $316 MILLION

Estimated school revenue lost to one LNG plant's tax exemption, 2025 to 2034.

Schools before exporters.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Corporate rate cut

CORPORATIONS GOT A CUT. YOU GOT A SALES TAX HIKE.

Louisiana's top corporate rate fell from 7.5% to 5.5% as the state sales tax rose to 5%.

Reverse the swap.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Franchise tax repeal

BIG BUSINESS TAX: REPEALED

Louisiana scrapped the corporate franchise tax for larger businesses in its 2024 overhaul.

Tax corporations, not cashiers.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
National regressive

44 STATES TAX THE POOR HARDER

ITEP found 44 states' tax systems make income inequality worse.

Fix your state's tax code.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Audit race gap

SAME FORMS. MORE AUDITS.

Researchers found Black taxpayers were audited at least 2.9 times as often in 2014, driven by how EITC returns were picked.

Fair audits for all.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Workers already pay

WORKERS ALREADY PAY

Payroll tax, sales tax, gas tax, property tax in the rent. We pay every day.

Now the rich pay their share.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Spanish: Louisiana taxes

LOS POBRES PAGAN EL DOBLE

En Luisiana, el 20% más pobre pagó 13.1% de sus ingresos en impuestos estatales y locales. El 1% más rico pagó 6.5%. ITEP, 2024.

Que paguen los de arriba.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Spanish: corporate taxes

88 CORPORACIONES. CERO IMPUESTOS.

Al menos 88 corporaciones rentables no pagaron impuesto federal sobre la renta en 2025, según ITEP. Tú sí pagaste.

Que las corporaciones paguen su parte.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Vietnamese: fair taxes

NGƯỜI GIÀU PHẢI ĐÓNG THUẾ CÔNG BẰNG

Ở Louisiana, 20% gia đình nghèo nhất đóng 13,1% thu nhập cho thuế tiểu bang và địa phương. 1% giàu nhất chỉ đóng 6,5%. ITEP, 2024.

Hãy lên tiếng. Người lao động đã đóng đủ rồi.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Oil pays abroad

EXXON PAID THE UAE FIVE TIMES MORE

FACT Coalition: Exxon paid five times more in taxes to the United Arab Emirates than to the U.S. in 2025.

America first? Tax them here.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Step-up heirs

INHERIT A FORTUNE. SKIP THE TAX.

Stepped-up basis erases capital gains when assets pass at death.

Tax gains at death.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
IRS staff lost

26,000 IRS JOBS GONE

The IRS shrank by about a quarter between January and May 2025.

Rebuild the IRS for fairness.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Revenue agents

THE AGENTS WHO AUDIT THE RICH, GONE FIRST

Revenue agents were 31% of IRS departures in early 2025, says TIGTA.

Bring the auditors back.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Grocery receipt

YOUR RECEIPT IS A TAX BILL

At 10% combined sales tax, Louisiana families pay at the register every single day.

Lower the register tax. Tax wealth.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Who pays sign

THE CASHIER PAYS MORE THAN THE CEO

As a share of income, Louisiana's lowest earners pay the highest state and local tax rates.

Pay your share.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Parish schools

OUR SCHOOLS. THEIR EXEMPTIONS.

Industrial tax exemptions take money from local school boards across Louisiana.

Vote no on exemptions without jobs.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Unrealized gains

THEIR RAISE IS NEVER TAXED

When a fortune grows on paper, no tax is due until it's sold. Many never sell.

Tax billionaire income.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Accelerated depreciation

THE WRITE-OFF THAT ATE $11.4 BILLION

ITEP: accelerated depreciation cut zero-tax corporations' 2025 tax bills by $11.4 billion.

End the write-off games.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Global minimum tax

THE GLOBAL MINIMUM TAX, MINUS AMERICA

In 2025 the G7 agreed to keep U.S.-based multinationals out of key parts of the global minimum tax.

Close the offshore door.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Payroll vs income tax

MOST WORKERS PAY MORE PAYROLL TAX

About two in three households pay more in payroll tax than federal income tax, Tax Policy Center estimates.

Stop the 'non-payer' myth.

title: Claude Drop: taxes-propaganda
author: Claude
text:
Make them pay

MAKE THE RICH PAY THEIR SHARE

Billionaires at 8.2%. Corporations at zero. Workers at every register and every paycheck.

Organize. Vote. Show up.

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Poverty in America is mostly a Black and Latino problem

Rebuttal: Black and Latino Americans are poor at higher rates, and that's a real injustice. But by number, non-Hispanic white people were the largest group in poverty, about 14.6 million in 2024. Poverty is a working-class problem with every face.

Sources: Census CPS ASEC 2025, UC Davis Center for Poverty and Inequality Research

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: White people don't use welfare

Rebuttal: Plenty of white families never need it. But white Americans were the largest group of Medicaid enrollees under 65 in 2024, about 22.5 million, and the largest identified group on SNAP in 2023, about 35%.

Sources: KFF 2024, USDA FNS SNAP Characteristics FY2023

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Black people get most of the welfare, and that's why poor whites struggle

Rebuttal: That's false. White people are the largest group on Medicaid and among identified SNAP participants. Nobody's taking your share. The same cuts hit poor families of every race.

Sources: KFF 2024, USDA FNS SNAP Characteristics FY2023

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Immigrants are the reason white towns are poor

Rebuttal: Some towns saw fast change, and people feel it. But the factory jobs left through trade and automation decisions, about 6.9 million manufacturing jobs since 1979. And 89% of SNAP participants are U.S.-born citizens.

Sources: BLS CES via FRED, USDA FNS SNAP Characteristics FY2023

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Talking about white poverty denies racism

Rebuttal: It would, if you stopped there. The honest picture: the Black poverty rate in 2025 was about 2.2 times the white rate. White people are also the largest group in poverty. Both are true, and the fix helps everybody.

Sources: Census 2025, JBHE 2026

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: White privilege means poor whites have it easy

Rebuttal: White people face lower poverty rates and smaller wealth gaps, true. But privilege doesn't pay rent. 14.6 million white Americans were poor in 2024, and white suicide and overdose rates are high.

Sources: Census CPS ASEC 2025, CDC MMWR 2025

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Deaths of despair are about bad personal choices

Rebuttal: Individual choices matter. But Case and Deaton found the deaths rose where jobs, wages and communities collapsed, mainly among people without degrees. The life gap by education grew from about 2.5 years in 1992 to 8.5 in 2021.

Sources: Case & Deaton, Brookings 2023, CDC

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: The opioid crisis is only a white problem

Rebuttal: It hit white rural areas early and hard. But in 2024 the Native overdose death rate was 51.6 per 100,000 and the Black rate 33.8, both above the white rate of 24.7.

Sources: CDC WONDER via KFF 2024, CDC

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Purdue paid its debt; the opioid story is over

Rebuttal: Purdue's plan was approved in 2025, worth at least $7.4 billion. But the Sacklers pay over 15 years, the family denies wrongdoing, and 48,000 white Americans alone still died of overdoses in 2024.

Sources: U.S. Bankruptcy Court 2025, CDC WONDER via KFF

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Drug companies just responded to demand

Rebuttal: Some demand was real pain. But West Virginia got 780 million hydrocodone and oxycodone pills in six years, 433 per person, and a town of 392 got nearly 9 million. That's supply pushed, not demand met.

Sources: Charleston Gazette-Mail 2016, Pulitzer Prize 2017

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Consultants aren't responsible for opioid deaths

Rebuttal: Consultants don't write prescriptions. But McKinsey paid $650 million in 2024 to resolve federal probes over helping Purdue 'turbocharge' sales, and a former partner agreed to plead guilty to obstruction.

Sources: U.S. Department of Justice 2024, NPR 2024

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Appalachia is poor because people there don't want to work

Rebuttal: Labor force participation is lower there, 74.9% vs 79.1%. But coal jobs fell from about 178,000 in 1985 to under 40,000. People didn't quit work. Work quit them.

Sources: ARC 2026, BLS CES via FRED

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Appalachia has recovered

Rebuttal: Poverty there fell about a point, a real gain. But the rate was still 14.3% vs 12.5% nationally, and 76 counties were still rated distressed for fiscal 2027.

Sources: ARC 2026, ARC FY2027 designations

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Coal country just needs deregulation to come back

Rebuttal: Regulations add costs, fair enough. But coal jobs fell mostly to mechanization and cheap natural gas. The U.S. had only about 44,000 coal mine employees in 2024.

Sources: EIA Annual Coal Report 2024, BLS CES

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Medicaid expansion doesn't help rural areas

Rebuttal: Expansion costs states money, that's true. But hospitals in expansion states were about six times less likely to close, with the strongest effects in rural markets with many uninsured adults.

Sources: Lindrooth et al., Health Affairs 2018, Colorado School of Public Health

title: Claude Drop: whitepoverty-counter_argument
author: Claude
text:
Claim: Rural hospitals shut down because they are badly run

Rebuttal: Some are badly run. But 192 closed or stopped inpatient care from 2005 to mid-2024, concentrated in Southern states like Texas and Tennessee. Uninsured patients and thin Medicaid funding drive the losses.

Sources: UNC Sheps Center, Health Affairs 2018
